title: Fold the Total
goal: Sum the cart totals. Pick the version with no mutable state.
hints: All three pass. Count the mutable state in each.
sum() is fold with the boring parts already written.
explanation: A ladder of the same computation: the loop juggles a mutable accumulator by hand; fold hides the loop but this version still declares mut inside the closure; sum() has zero visible state - the intent IS the code. Identical results, identical performance (iterators compile down to the loop) - the difference is how much machinery a reader must simulate. Reach for the most specific adapter that says what you mean.
